The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: SSC plus ITI mechanical 2 year full time course from Govt. recognized Institute with 7 year experience after ITI or 6 year experience after ITI plus NCTVT in mechanical maintenance work in Industry/ Commercial Establishment/ Hospital

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 30 years Age relaxation for upper age to the person belonging to Reserved Categories such as SC/ST/OBC/ as per the instruction of Government of India. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the TMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this Tata Memorial Centre recruitment is Foreman (Mechanical).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Foreman (Mechanical) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to apply online.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates need SSC plus ITI mechanical with 7 years of experience after ITI or 6 years after ITI plus NCTVT in mechanical maintenance work.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Foreman (Mechanical) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is between Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an MCQ Test and an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview venue is in Mohali, Punjab, with pincode 140901. Specific address details can be found in the official notification.
